passage: The transition to quantum computing presents both unprecedented computational power and severe cryptographic vulnerabilities. While quantum algorithms can rapidly factorize large integers—undermining widely-used RSA encryption—post-quantum cryptography is simultaneously being developed to construct lattice-based algorithms impervious to quantum decryption.

options: It offers immense computing potential while threatening foundational data security standards.
It makes lattice-based systems obsolete while strengthening RSA encryption.
It accelerates algorithmic speed but proves too costly for cryptographic deployment.
It relies entirely on classical encryption architectures to solve complex factorizations.
